# CodeCanyon

> CodeCanyon is a digital marketplace offering 38,000+ plugins, scripts, and code components for web and mobile development across PHP, JavaScript, WordPress, and other technologies.

CodeCanyon serves as a curated platform where developers can discover, purchase, and sell pre-built code solutions, plugins, and scripts. The marketplace features top-ranked authors, weekly-picked items, and user collections organized by category and compatibility filters.

## Key Topics

- WordPress Plugins
- PHP Scripts
- JavaScript Code
- HTML5
- Bootstrap
- SaaS Products
- Mobile Apps
- Digital Products
- Web Development
- Code Snippets
- Plugins & Templates
- QR Code Generator
- Social Media Automation
- Featured Files
- Code Marketplace

## Marketplace Discovery

- [Buy Plugins & Code from CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net): CodeCanyon homepage: marketplace for 38k+ plugins, scripts, and code across multiple technologies
- [Featured Files | CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/feature): Featured and weekly-picked code snippets, scripts, and plugins on CodeCanyon marketplace
- [Browse Categories | CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/category): Category browser for JavaScript, PHP, .NET scripts and code components
- [Public Collections | CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/collections): User-curated collections of code, templates, and assets across Envato network
- [Buy Plugins & Code from CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/follow_feed): User feed for discovering plugins, scripts, and digital assets on CodeCanyon

## Technology & Compatibility

- [Plugins, Code & Scripts with Compatible With: elementor](https://codecanyon.net/attributes/compatible-with/elementor): Filter view: 1,633 Elementor-compatible WordPress plugins and extensions

## Top Authors & Developers

- [CodeCanyon Top Authors](https://codecanyon.net/authors/top): Leaderboard of bestselling developers and top-ranked authors on CodeCanyon
- [Top New Authors | CodeCanyon](https://codecanyon.net/page/top_new_sellers): Ranking of emerging and newly successful sellers on CodeCanyon marketplace
